welcome.title: Welcome to Atlas
welcome.lead: A team of AI agents researches everything tradable on OKX and proposes trades. Then the risk engine, plain code with no AI in it, checks each proposal against the limits you set. No order reaches OKX before that.

f1.title: Starts on the demo account
f1.body: The demo account trades paper money, never your own funds. Live trading is a separate switch for later, behind your password and a checklist.

f2.title: Agents propose, code decides
f2.body: No agent can place an order. The risk engine approves or rejects each one, using your limits.

f3.title: Your keys stay on this Mac
f3.body: Keys are encrypted here, shown only as their last four characters, and never sent to the AI.

welcome.risk: Automated trading can lose money. Start on demo, and set limits you can live with.

connect.title: Connect your OKX demo account
connect.lead: Paste the API key you created for demo trading. Atlas saves it encrypted on this Mac, then tests it with OKX.
connect.continueHint: Continue unlocks after a successful test.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load your connection
loadError.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running, then try again.

risk.title: Choose a risk profile
risk.lead: It sets the ten limits the risk engine applies to every trade. You can change any of them later in Settings.

autonomy.title: Choose how much Atlas does on its own
autonomy.lead: Start by approving each trade yourself. Levels 3 and 4 open in a later phase.

cf.label: Label
cf.passphraseHint: The passphrase you chose when you created the key on OKX.

required.apiKey: Paste the API key from OKX.
required.secret: Paste the secret key from OKX.

cf.invalid: OKX keys don’t look like this. Paste it again, exactly as OKX showed it.

where.title: Create a demo key with Read and Trade only
where.body: In OKX, switch to Demo trading, then open Profile → API keys → Create. Tick Read and Trade. Never tick Withdraw.

cf.savedMeta: API key <fig>•••• {{last4}}</fig>. Atlas never shows a saved key again.

success.title: Connected to OKX demo
success.body: Atlas can read this account. Syncing starts as soon as you finish setup.

tr.sealLabel: Seal of the OKX demo account ending {{last4}}

spot.title: This account is in Spot mode
spot.body: Atlas can read it, but trading perpetuals later needs Spot and futures mode or a margin mode. Switch it in OKX demo settings whenever you’re ready.

withdrawWarning.title: This key can withdraw funds
withdrawWarning.body: Atlas never withdraws or transfers money, and demo funds are paper money. Still, create a key with Read and Trade only when you can, and use only that kind of key for live trading.

invalid_credentials.title: Key or passphrase is wrong
invalid_credentials.body: OKX didn’t accept these details. Paste the API key, secret key and passphrase again, exactly as OKX showed them.

withdraw_permission_enabled.title: This key can withdraw funds
withdraw_permission_enabled.body: Atlas refuses keys with Withdraw permission here. In OKX, create a new key with Read and Trade only, then paste it here.

wrong_environment.title: This key belongs to the live account
wrong_environment.body: Create the key under Demo trading in OKX, then paste it here.

trading_core_unavailable.title: Atlas’s trading service isn’t running
trading_core_unavailable.body: Start it with ./atlas up in Terminal, then test again.

ip_not_allowed.title: This key only works from the IP addresses on its allow-list
ip_not_allowed.body: Add this Mac’s IP address to the key in OKX, or create a key without an IP allow-list, then test again.

clock_out_of_sync.title: This Mac’s clock is out of sync with OKX
clock_out_of_sync.body: Turn on “Set time and date automatically” in System Settings → General → Date & Time, then test again.

key_frozen.title: This key is frozen on OKX
key_frozen.body: Unfreeze it or create a new demo key in OKX, then paste it here.

key_not_found.title: OKX does not know this key
key_not_found.body: It may have been deleted. Create a new demo key in OKX, then paste it here.

decrypt_failed.title: Atlas couldn’t read the saved key
decrypt_failed.body: The trading service uses a different APP_KEY from the server. Restart Atlas with ./atlas up, then test again.

okx_unreachable.title: Atlas couldn’t reach OKX
okx_unreachable.body: Check this Mac’s internet connection, then test again.

okx_error.title: OKX refused the request
okx_error.body: OKX answered with error {{code}}. Try again in a minute; if it keeps happening, create a new demo key.

trading_core_error.title: Atlas’s trading service failed
trading_core_error.body: It answered with an error. Restart Atlas with ./atlas up, then test again.

unknown.title: The test didn’t finish
unknown.body: Something went wrong between Atlas and OKX. Try again.
